scripts.text:
[Rachel Guide]
Welcome to the capital of
Arunafeltz, Rachel where a warm
breath of goddess Freya reaches.
If this is the first time for you
to use the guide services, why
don't you check the "Notice" menu first?
scripts.translation:
[拉赫向导]
欢迎来到阿鲁纳菲兹的首都——拉赫，
这里能感受到女神芙蕾雅温暖的呼吸。
如果您是第一次使用向导服务，
不妨先查看一下“告示”菜单？

scripts.text: Village Guide
scripts.translation: 村庄向导

scripts.text: Remove Marks from Mini-Map
scripts.translation: 移除小地图标记

scripts.text: Notice
scripts.translation: 告示

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Rachel Guide]
I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Rachel.
So where do you want to go?
Would you like me
to mark locations
on your Mini-Map?
scripts.translation:
[拉赫向导]
只要是在拉赫境内的建筑，我都能告诉您位置。
那么，您想去哪里？
需要我在小地图上
标记位置吗？

scripts.text:

[Rachel Guide]
Cheshrumnir is a holy ground where pope, the incarnation of goddess Freya stays.
Take the road to the norh to find the building.

那么，您想去哪里？
[拉赫向导]
瑟斯隆尼勒是圣地，女神芙蕾雅的化身——教皇就居住在那里。
请沿着北边的道路走，就能找到那座建筑。

scripts.text:

I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Rachel.

[Rachel Guide]

The left building next to me is the Inn of Rachel.

scripts.text:
[Rachel Guide]
When you are using the ''Village Guide'' menu,
make sure that building locations will be marked on your mini-map at the upper right side of your screen.
If you cannot see your mini-map, use the short cut key ''ctrl+tab'' or press the ''Map'' button on your basic information windows, okay?
And you can also zoom out your mini-map by using the ''-'' button in case you cannot view the entire map of the village.
scripts.translation:
[拉赫向导]
当您使用“村庄向导”菜单时，
请注意建筑位置会标记在屏幕右上角的小地图上。
如果您看不到小地图，请使用快捷键“Ctrl+Tab”或按下基本信息窗口中的“地图”按钮，好吗？
如果您无法查看整个村庄地图，也可以使用“-”按钮缩小小地图。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Guide]
Hope you have a wonderfull journey
in Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[拉赫向导]
祝您在阿鲁纳菲兹的旅程愉快。
